investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Riverpine Media (news and media publishing); Platform: AWS ap-south-1 (zones ap-south-1a/ap-south-1b/ap-south-1c); network range 10.221.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster riverp-prod-apsout (EKS); Streaming: Kafka cluster of three brokers (single log directory each); topic comment-events uses replication factor 2 and min.insync.replicas 2; producer comment-svc, consumer media-api; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
